caption:
Figure 3. Different Visual Overlaps under the Same Frame In-
terval. Two sequences from DL3DV [34] share the same frame in-
terval yet exhibit drastically different levels of visual overlap. Our
proposed semantic and geometric overlap metrics more accurately
capture the true difficulty (or camera motion) of each sequence.
